contractSchemas.policy: Use the published @opensoha/contracts schemas when installed. Use the sibling soha-contracts checkout only for local development before public release artifacts are available. Local repository schemas may be stricter for official assets, but must remain compatible with these public contracts.

wrapperPackage.install: Install the versioned soha-skills release package that matches skillsVersion.
wrapperPackage.upgrade: Upgrade only after validating the release manifest, checksum, compatibility matrix, and validation report.
wrapperPackage.rollback: Reinstall the previous versioned wrapper package and restore its matching validation report and manifest.

rawSkillsRuntime.install: Expand the verified skills runtime from the release package into a versioned staging directory before activating it.
rawSkillsRuntime.upgrade: Switch the active runtime pointer only after validation passes and the target CLI can load the new index.
rawSkillsRuntime.rollback: Switch the active runtime pointer back to the previous verified directory and keep the failed version for audit.
